newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican lawyer held in bombing probe.
newsitem.headline: Corsican lawyer held in bombing probe.

text.p: Marie-Helene Mattei, a lawyer and close friend of Corsican separatist leader Francois Santoni, was detained on Monday over suspected links to a bomb attack on an island golf club, police sources said.
Mattei is the lawyer of Cuncolta Naziunalista, the legal wing of the banned Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC).
Cuncolta leader Santoni has been in hiding to avoid charges of arms violations, though he appeared in a television interview on Friday, urging talks with President Jacques Chirac.
Six people were already in custody for suspected involvement in Thursday's attack on the Sperone golf course, which investigators believe was linked to an extortion racket by Corsican separatists.
The bomb flattened the building but there were no injuries. The FLNC claimed responsibilty for the bombing, accusing the golf course owners of letting French commandos use the building.
The FLNC said in a statement last week it planned "new forms" of attacks on the mainland in its campaign for increased autonomy.
Corsican separatists made a rare daytime bomb attack on Sunday, damaging a firm owned by the son of a conservative politician on the north of the island.
